Paths are relative to the fixture. An expectedFinding is a subset of a finding, not an exhaustive response schema.

write.api.ts:
export function first(a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number, e: number, f: number) { return a + b + c + d + e + f; }
export function last(a: string, b: string, c: string, d: string, e: string, f: string) { return [f, e, d, c, b, a].join(''); }
export function total(values: readonly number[]) { return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0); }
